title: Story contract rules
summary: The BOXED IN lesson and the nine-sentence story contract (want, stakes, constraint, choice, escalation, knowledge, plant, reversal, consequence) to write before drawing shots, with the longer-film scaffold.
evidence_notes: Editorial guidance from the owner's guide, written after Taylor rejected BOXED IN's story quality. Its review methods (table read, silent animatic, owner storyboard choice) are proposed; nothing here is validated audience research.
